limitations: This retains files if temporary directory names are removed. It is not an independent backup: an in-place write to an image changes both linked names.
storage: Persistent hardlinks retain TIFF image inputs on the same filesystem; PNG masks and JSON metadata are independently copied. All original source bytes and paths remain unchanged.
initial_record_note: The initial stdout field independent_metadata_copies counted all non-TIFF files (PNG masks plus JSON), not JSON alone. This audited record corrects the label; original stdout and JSON remain preserved.
